nodes.name: On workflow failure
nodes.notes: Attach to any workflow with the Settings → Error Workflow selector.

nodes.name: Summarise without secrets
nodes.notes: Redacts keys, bearer tokens and query strings before notifying.

nodes.name: Deduplicate
nodes.notes: Static data survives restarts for active workflows; one alert per workflow per window instead of an alert storm.

nodes.name: Notify admin (Telegram)
nodes.notes: Disabled until a Telegram credential is selected.

nodes.name: Notify admin (email)
nodes.notes: Enable either this or the Telegram node, not both.

meta.description: Error Trigger → redact → dedupe → notify. Alerts carry no student text.
